available_exploration_history.hypothesis: Prioritizing inspection of open horizontal surfaces before opening closed storage receptacles reduces total search actions compared to strictly following the listed observation order.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: visit an open horizontal surface first; if empty, visit a closed storage receptacle next, opening it before inspection
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-and-place tasks where the target object is not immediately visible and the room contains both open surfaces and closed storage receptacles

available_exploration_history.hypothesis: For food items requiring downstream cooling, prioritizing navigation to food-preparation appliances (e.g., toasters, microwaves) before inspecting general open horizontal surfaces or closed storage receptacles reduces total search actions by targeting semantically likely spawn locations first.
available_exploration_history.realization_pattern: visit a food-preparation appliance first; if empty, visit an open horizontal surface next; if still empty, visit a closed storage receptacle, opening it before inspection
available_exploration_history.scope: ALFWorld pick-cool-then-place tasks where the target object is a food item not immediately visible in the entry observation and the room contains both open surfaces, closed storage receptacles, and food-preparation appliances.

functional_contract.local_function: Search environment receptacles to locate and acquire the target pan object.
